intro.en: In this lesson we read about the Quran as the lasting miracle of the Messenger ﷺ: how it was revealed in parts, its inimitability, Makki and Madani surahs, and how it was collected. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum Quran ke baare mein parhenge ke woh Rasool ﷺ ka hamesha rehne wala mojiza hai: yeh thoda thoda kaise nazil hua, iska mojiza hona, Makki aur Madani suratein, aur Quran kaise jama kiya gaya. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هَذَا الدَّرْسِ عَنِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، المُعْجِزَةِ الخالِدَةِ لِلرَّسولِ ﷺ: نُزولِهِ مُنَجَّماً، وَإِعْجازِهِ، وَالسُّوَرِ المَكِّيَّةِ وَالمَدَنِيَّة، وَجَمْعِهِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَة.

dialogue.ar: القُرْآنُ مُعْجِزَةُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ، أَنْزَلَهُ اللهُ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى عَلَيْهِ مُنَجَّماً حَسَبَ الحَوادِثِ.
dialogue.tr: al-Qurʾānu muʿjizatu r-rasūl, anzalahu llāhu subḥānahu wa taʿālā ʿalayhi munajjaman ḥasaba l-ḥawādith
dialogue.en: The Quran is the miracle of the Messenger ﷺ. Allah, glorified and exalted, revealed it to him in parts, according to events.
dialogue.ur: Quran Rasool ﷺ ka mojiza hai. Allah ne use waqiaat ke mutabiq thoda thoda un par nazil kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَالحِكْمَةُ مِنْ ذلِكَ تَثْبيتُ قَلْبِ الرَّسولِ ﷺ وَقُلوبِ المُسْلِمين، وَلِيَكونَ حِفْظُهُ سَهْلاً عَلَيْهِم.
dialogue.tr: wal-ḥikmatu min dhālika tathbītu qalbi r-rasūl wa qulūbi l-muslimīn, wa li-yakūna ḥifẓuhu sahlan ʿalayhim
dialogue.en: The wisdom in that is to strengthen the heart of the Messenger ﷺ and the hearts of the Muslims, and to make memorising it easy for them.
dialogue.ur: Is mein hikmat yeh hai ke Rasool ﷺ aur musalmanon ke dil mazboot hon aur unke liye hifz aasaan ho.

dialogue.ar: كانَتْ لِلرَّسولِ ﷺ مُعْجِزاتٌ أُخْرى، وَمِنْها: انْشِقاقُ القَمَرِ، وَخُروجُ الماءِ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصابِعِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kānat lil-rasūl muʿjizātun ukhrā, wa minhā inshiqāqu l-qamar, wa khurūju l-māʾi min bayni aṣābiʿih
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ had other miracles too, among them the splitting of the moon and water flowing from between his fingers.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ke aur bhi mojizaat the, unmein chand ka phatna aur unki ungliyon ke darmiyan se paani nikalna hai.

dialogue.ar: كَما كانَتْ لِلرُّسُلِ قَبْلَهُ مُعْجِزاتٌ؛ كَالعَصا مُعْجِزَةِ موسى عَلَيْهِ السَّلام، وَالنّاقَةِ مُعْجِزَةِ صالِحٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلام.
dialogue.tr: kamā kānat lil-rusuli qablahu muʿjizāt; kal-ʿaṣā muʿjizati Mūsā, wan-nāqati muʿjizati Ṣāliḥ
dialogue.en: The messengers before him also had miracles, like the staff of Musa and the she-camel of Salih, peace be upon them.
dialogue.ur: Un se pehle rasoolon ke bhi mojizaat the, jaise Musa عليه السلام ka asa aur Salih عليه السلام ki untni.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا مُعْجِزَةُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ الخالِدَةُ فَهِيَ القُرْآنُ الكَريم، وَهِيَ باقِيَةٌ إلى يَوْمِ القِيامَة.
dialogue.tr: ammā muʿjizatu r-rasūl al-khālidatu fa-hiya l-Qurʾānu l-karīm, wa hiya bāqiyatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāma
dialogue.en: As for the eternal miracle of the Messenger ﷺ, it is the Noble Quran, and it remains until the Day of Resurrection.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ka hamesha rehne wala mojiza Quran-e-Kareem hai, aur yeh qiyamat tak baaqi rahega.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنّا لَهُ لَحافِظونَ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: innā naḥnu nazzalnā dh-dhikra wa innā lahu laḥāfiẓūn
dialogue.en: Allah the Exalted said: Indeed, We sent down the Reminder, and indeed We will guard it. [Al-Hijr 9]
dialogue.ur: Allah ne farmaya: Beshak hum ne yeh Zikr nazil kiya aur beshak hum hi uski hifazat karne wale hain. [Al-Hijr 9]

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ تَحَدّى القُرْآنُ الإِنْسَ وَالجِنَّ لِيَأْتوا بِمِثْلِهِ، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطيعوا.
dialogue.tr: wa qad taḥaddā l-Qurʾānu l-insa wal-jinna li-yaʾtū bi-mithlih, fa-lam yastaṭīʿū
dialogue.en: The Quran challenged mankind and the jinn to bring the like of it, and they could not.
dialogue.ur: Quran ne insanon aur jinnon ko challenge kiya ke iss jaisa le aayen, lekin woh na la sake.

dialogue.ar: القُرْآنُ مُعْجِزٌ بِأُسْلوبِهِ وَأَلْفاظِهِ وَمَعانيهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-Qurʾānu muʿjizun bi-uslūbihi wa alfāẓihi wa maʿānīh
dialogue.en: The Quran is miraculous in its style, its words and its meanings.
dialogue.ur: Quran apne andaz, alfaaz aur maani mein mojiza hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَبْلُغُ القُرْآنُ المَكِّيُّ نَحْوَ ثُلُثَيِ القُرْآن.
dialogue.tr: wa yabluġu l-Qurʾānu l-makkiyyu naḥwa thuluthayi l-Qurʾān
dialogue.en: The Makki Quran makes up about two thirds of the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Makki Quran taqriban Quran ka do tihai hissa hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَمّا القُرْآنُ المَدَنِيُّ فَجاءَتْ سُوَرُهُ وَآياتُهُ طَويلَةً في الغالِب.
dialogue.tr: wa ammā l-Qurʾānu l-madaniyyu fa-jāʾat suwaruhu wa āyātuhu ṭawīlatan fil-ghālib
dialogue.en: As for the Madani Quran, its surahs and verses mostly came long.
dialogue.ur: Madani Quran ki suratein aur aayaat aam taur par lambi hain.

dialogue.ar: اسْتَغْرَقَ نُزولُ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ مُدَّةَ ثَلاثَةٍ وَعِشْرينَ عاماً.
dialogue.tr: istaghraqa nuzūlu l-Qurʾāni l-karīmi muddata thalāthatin wa ʿishrīna ʿāmā
dialogue.en: The revelation of the Noble Quran took twenty-three years.
dialogue.ur: Quran-e-Kareem ke nuzool mein teis (23) saal lage.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ أَوَّلُ جَمْعٍ لِلْقُرْآنِ في مُصْحَفٍ واحِدٍ في عَهْدِ الخَليفَةِ الأَوَّلِ أَبي بَكْرٍ الصِّدّيقِ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa kāna awwalu jamʿin lil-Qurʾāni fī muṣḥafin wāḥid fī ʿahdi l-khalīfati l-awwal Abī Bakr aṣ-Ṣiddīq raḍiya llāhu ʿanh
dialogue.en: The first collecting of the Quran into one book was in the time of the first caliph, Abu Bakr as-Siddiq, may Allah be pleased with him.
dialogue.ur: Quran ko ek mushaf mein pehli baar jama karna pehle khalifa Abu Bakr Siddiq رضي الله عنه ke zamane mein hua.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ دُوِّنَ القُرْآنُ في عَهْدِ عُثْمانَ رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ، وَأَمَرَ بِكِتابَةِ نُسَخٍ مِنْهُ أُرْسِلَ مِنْها نُسْخَةٌ إلى كُلِّ بَلَدٍ.
dialogue.tr: thumma duwwina l-Qurʾānu fī ʿahdi ʿUthmān raḍiya llāhu ʿanh, wa amara bi-kitābati nusakhin minhu ursila minhā nuskhatun ilā kulli balad
dialogue.en: Then the Quran was compiled in the time of Uthman, may Allah be pleased with him, and he ordered copies written, one of which was sent to every land.
dialogue.ur: Phir Uthman رضي الله عنه ke zamane mein Quran likha gaya, unhon ne naskhe likhne ka hukm diya aur har shehar ko ek nuskha bheja gaya.

vocab.en: a bound copy of the Quran

q.en: According to the text, what is the eternal miracle of the Messenger ﷺ?
q.ur: Text ke mutabiq Rasool ﷺ ka hamesha rehne wala mojiza kya hai?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، ما المُعْجِزَةُ الخالِدَةُ لِلرَّسولِ ﷺ؟

q.en: Why was the Quran revealed in parts?
q.ur: Quran thoda thoda kyun nazil hua?

options: To strengthen hearts and make memorising easy
To make it harder to learn
Because people asked for the Torah
It was not revealed in parts

q.en: How long did the revelation of the Quran take?
q.ur: Quran ke nuzool mein kitna waqt laga?

q.en: Who first collected the Quran into one muṣḥaf?
q.ur: Quran ko pehli baar ek mushaf mein kisne jama kiya?
q.ar: مَنْ جَمَعَ القُرْآنَ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ في مُصْحَفٍ واحِد؟

intro.en: Here we practise the new words of the text: finding synonyms, matching verbs with their prepositions, and using words like مُعْجِزَة and هِجْرَة in sentences.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum text ke naye alfaaz ki mashq karte hain: hum-maani alfaaz dhoondhna, fel ko uske harf-e-jar se milana, aur mojiza, hijrat jaise alfaaz jumlon mein istemal karna.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى كَلِماتِ النَّصِّ الجَديدَة: إِيجادِ المُرادِفات، وَرَبْطِ الأَفْعالِ بِحُروفِ الجَرِّ الَّتي تُناسِبُها، وَاسْتِعْمالِ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلِ مُعْجِزَة وَهِجْرَة في جُمَل.

q.ur: "Nabi (bohat se)" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: A simple sentence has a subject and a predicate: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. When we put كانَ or one of its sisters before it, the subject stays raised (marfūʿ) and the predicate becomes accusative (manṣūb): كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً – The man was asleep. The sisters include صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ and ما بَرِحَ.
intro.ur: Aam jumla mubtada aur khabar se banta hai: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. Jab hum us se pehle كانَ ya uski behnein lagate hain to mubtada marfoo rehta hai aur khabar mansoob ho jati hai: كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً – Aadmi soya hua tha. Behnein: صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ, ما بَرِحَ.
intro.ar: الجُمْلَةُ الاسْمِيَّةُ لَها مُبْتَدَأٌ وَخَبَر: الرَّجُلُ نائِمٌ. وَإِذا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْها «كانَ» أَوْ إِحْدى أَخَواتِها بَقِيَ المُبْتَدَأُ مَرْفوعاً وَصارَ الخَبَرُ مَنْصوباً: كانَ الرَّجُلُ نائِماً. وَمِنْ أَخَواتِها: صارَ، أَصْبَحَ، أَضْحى، أَمْسى، ظَلَّ، لَيْسَ، ما دامَ، ما زالَ، ما بَرِحَ.

q.en: What case does the predicate take after كانَ?
q.ur: Kana ke baad khabar kis haalat mein aati hai?

q.en: Which word is a sister of كانَ?
q.ur: Kana ki behen kaun sa lafz hai?

q.ar: ما مَعْنى «لَيْسَ» في نَحْوِ «لَيْسَ الطّالِبُ غائِباً»؟

intro.en: Listen to the audio about the Quran, then answer true or false. Useful facts: the Quran came down in parts, it is also called al-Kitāb, al-Dhikr and al-Furqān, and it was collected to protect it from being lost.
intro.ur: Quran ke baare mein audio sunein, phir sahi ya ghalat ka jawab dein. Aham baatein: Quran thoda thoda nazil hua, isse al-Kitab, az-Zikr aur al-Furqan bhi kehte hain, aur isse zaaya hone se bachane ke liye jama kiya gaya.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى التَّسْجيلِ عَنِ القُرْآنِ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأ. مِنَ الحَقائِق: نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ مُنَجَّماً، وَمِنْ أَسْمائِهِ الكِتابُ وَالذِّكْرُ وَالفُرْقان، وَجُمِعَ لِحِفْظِهِ مِنَ الضَّياع.

vocab.ur: furqan, haq-batil mein farq karne wala

q.en: Was the Quran revealed all at once?
q.ur: Kya Quran ek hi baar mein nazil hua?

q.en: Which is a name of the Quran?
q.ur: Quran ka naam kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هَذِهِ الكَلِماتِ مِنْ أَسْماءِ القُرْآن؟

options_ar: الطَّريقُ الواضِحُ الَّذي لا اعْوِجاجَ فيه

intro.en: Practise asking and answering questions about the Quran with a partner, then write a short essay of at least 150 words titled «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» using the guiding questions.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath Quran ke baare mein sawal jawab ki mashq karein, phir «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» ke unwan par kam az kam 150 alfaaz ka mazmoon rehnumai ke sawalon ki madad se likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلِكَ عَلى طَرْحِ الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالإِجابَةِ عَنْها حَوْلَ القُرْآنِ الكَريم. ثُمَّ اكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاً لا يَقِلُّ عَنْ مِئَةٍ وَخَمْسينَ كَلِمَةً بِعُنْوانِ «القُرْآنُ الكَريم» مُسْتَعيناً بِالأَسْئِلَةِ المُوَجِّهَة.

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَحْفَظُ مِنْ كِتابِ اللهِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā taḥfaẓu min kitābi llāh?
dialogue.en: What do you memorise from the Book of Allah?
dialogue.ur: Aap Allah ki kitaab se kya yaad karte hain?

dialogue.ar: ما السِّنُّ المُناسِبَةُ لِحِفْظِ القُرْآنِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā s-sinnu l-munāsibatu li-ḥifẓi l-Qurʾān?
dialogue.en: What is the suitable age for memorising the Quran?
dialogue.ur: Quran hifz karne ki munasib umar kaun si hai?

dialogue.ar: ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ لِحِفْظِ القُرْآنِ؟
dialogue.tr: mā l-waqtu l-munāsibu li-ḥifẓi l-Qurʾān?
dialogue.en: What is the suitable time for memorising the Quran?
dialogue.ur: Quran hifz karne ka munasib waqt kaun sa hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ قِراءَةَ القُرْآنِ أَمِ الاسْتِماعَ إِلَيْهِ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tufaḍḍilu qirāʾata l-Qurʾāni ami l-istimāʿa ilayh? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you prefer reading the Quran or listening to it? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap Quran parhna pasand karte hain ya sunna? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْرِفُ اسْماً آخَرَ لِلْقُرْآنِ الكَريمِ؟ ما هُوَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal taʿrifu ismān ākhara lil-Qurʾāni l-karīm? mā huwa?
dialogue.en: Do you know another name for the Noble Quran? What is it?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap Quran-e-Kareem ka koi aur naam jaante hain? Woh kya hai?

q.ar: ما مَعْنى «تُفَضِّلُ» في سُؤالِ «أَيَّ السُّوَرِ تُفَضِّل؟»

q.ur: «ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ؟» kis ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: عَنْ ماذا يَسْأَلُ سُؤالُ «ما الوَقْتُ المُناسِبُ؟»

title.en: Spelling: the soft alif in verbs

intro.en: A verb ending in a long ā sound is written with alif (ا) or yā' without dots (ى). For three-letter verbs: if the original letter is wāw, write alif (دَعا); if it is yā', write ى (سَعى). For longer verbs: write alif if a yā' comes before it (يَحْيا), otherwise write ى (اهْتَدى).
intro.ur: Jis fel ke aakhir mein lambi aa ki awaz ho woh alif (ا) ya be-nuqta ya (ى) se likha jata hai. Teen harfi fel mein agar asal harf waw ho to alif likhte hain (دَعا), agar ya ho to ى (سَعى). Teen se zyada harfon mein agar alif se pehle ya ho to alif (يَحْيا), warna ى (اهْتَدى).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ المُنْتَهي بِأَلِفٍ لَيِّنَةٍ يُكْتَبُ بِأَلِفٍ (ا) أَوْ بِياءٍ بِلا نُقَطٍ (ى). في الفِعْلِ الثُّلاثِيِّ: إِنْ كانَ أَصْلُ الأَلِفِ واواً كُتِبَتْ أَلِفاً (دَعا)، وَإِنْ كانَ ياءً كُتِبَتْ ى (سَعى). وَفي ما زادَ عَلى ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُفٍ: تُكْتَبُ أَلِفاً إِنْ سَبَقَتْها ياءٌ (يَحْيا)، وَإِلّا فَتُكْتَبُ ى (اهْتَدى).

q.ur: «دَعا» kaise likha jata hai aur kyun?

options: With alif, because the root letter is wāw
With ى, because the root letter is wāw
With ى, because it has four letters
With alif, because it is a noun

q.ur: «يَحْيا» alif par kyun khatam hota hai?

options: a yā' comes before the final sound

q.ar: بِمَ يَنْتَهي الفِعْلُ «اهْتَدى» وَهُوَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ ثَلاثَةِ أَحْرُف؟

q.en: Which verb is written with ى?
q.ur: Kaun sa fel ى se likha jata hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ الأَفْعالِ الآتِيَةِ يُكْتَبُ بِـ ى؟

title.en: Grammar: Inna and its sisters; review
title.ur: Qawaid: Inna aur uski behnein; dohrai

intro.en: Inna and its sisters (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) enter a simple sentence and do the opposite of كانَ: the subject becomes accusative and the predicate stays raised. Example: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ becomes إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ – Indeed, the religion is ease.
intro.ur: Inna aur uski behnein (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) jumle par aakar Kana ke ulta kaam karti hain: mubtada mansoob ho jata hai aur khabar marfoo rehti hai. Misal: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ se إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ – Beshak deen aasaani hai.
intro.ar: «إِنَّ» وَأَخَواتُها (إِنَّ، أَنَّ، كَأَنَّ، لَكِنَّ، لَيْتَ، لَعَلَّ) تَدْخُلُ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاسْمِيَّةِ فَتَعْمَلُ عَكْسَ «كانَ»: يُنْصَبُ المُبْتَدَأُ وَيَبْقى الخَبَرُ مَرْفوعاً. مِثال: الدِّينُ يُسْرٌ ← إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna d-dīna yusr
dialogue.en: Indeed, the religion is ease.
dialogue.ur: Beshak deen aasaani hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ أَبا بَكْرٍ أَوَّلُ الخُلَفاءِ الرّاشِدينَ.
dialogue.tr: inna Abā Bakrin awwalu l-khulafāʾi r-rāshidīn
dialogue.en: Indeed, Abu Bakr is the first of the rightly guided caliphs.
dialogue.ur: Beshak Abu Bakr pehle khulafa-e-rashideen hain.

dialogue.ar: زَيْدٌ طالِبٌ، وَلَكِنَّ عُمَرَ مُعَلِّمٌ.
dialogue.tr: Zaydun ṭālib, wa lākinna ʿUmara muʿallim
dialogue.en: Zayd is a student, but Umar is a teacher.
dialogue.ur: Zaid talib-e-ilm hai, lekin Umar ustaad hai.

dialogue.ar: كَأَنَّ السَّفينَةَ جَبَلٌ.
dialogue.tr: ka-anna s-safīnata jabal
dialogue.en: It is as if the ship were a mountain.
dialogue.ur: Goya kashti pahaad hai.

dialogue.ar: لَعَلَّ المُؤْمِناتِ راغِباتٌ في العِلْمِ.
dialogue.tr: laʿalla l-muʾmināti rāghibātun fil-ʿilm
dialogue.en: Perhaps the believing women are eager for knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Shayad momin aurtein ilm ki khwahish mand hain.

dialogue.ar: لَيْتَ المُعَلِّمَ حاضِرٌ مَعَنا.
dialogue.tr: layta l-muʿallima ḥāḍirun maʿanā
dialogue.en: If only the teacher were present with us.
dialogue.ur: Kaash ustaad hamare saath hazir hote.

q.en: What happens to the subject after إِنَّ?
q.ur: Inna ke baad mubtada ka kya hota hai?
"Kaash" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
